thread:
maya: quick alert 1: swapped prefill default to FA-v2 (paged variant) in the canary cluster. Prefill throughput looks strong but tiny decode requests are suffering. Need a short triage thread. :warning:

sam: ack. drop perf numbers + selector rules? what hardware/precision? :clipboard:

maya: A100 fp16. Selector used in canary: prefill -> paged-FA-v2, decode -> paged-FA-v2 (no exceptions). Microbench snapshot:
```
prefill (seq=1024): paged-FA-v2: 1600 tok/s, FA-v1: 1370 tok/s
decode (b=1, seq=12): fused-attn: 112 tok/s, paged-FA-v2: 62 tok/s, FA-v1: 98 tok/s
decode (b=3, seq=12): fused-attn: 320 tok/s, paged-FA-v2: 190 tok/s
```
End-to-end median decode latency up ~30% on canary.

jun: that delta screams kernel-launch overhead + KV cache page churn for paged-FA-v2 on decode. Did anyone run Nsight/nvprof traces? :mag:

ciara: I captured a couple traces. Short findings:
- paged-FA-v2 (decode,b=1,seq=12): ~72 kernel launches in the causal loop, many small kernels; avg launch latency ~0.25ms; L2 read bandwidth ~30GB/s.
- fused-attn (same): ~22 launches; avg launch latency ~0.9ms; L2 read ~14GB/s.
- paged-FA-v2 shows higher DRAM reads due to repeated KV page touches when eviction boundary is hit.
Full flamegraph uploaded to the perf bucket.

maya: nvprof excerpt (abridged):
```
paged-FA-v2 decode (b=1,seq=12):
KernelLaunches: 72
AvgLatency/launch: 0.25ms
L2 Read: 30GB/s

fused-attn decode (b=1,seq=12):
KernelLaunches: 22
AvgLatency/launch: 0.88ms
L2 Read: 14GB/s
```
Point is paged-FA-v2 breaks work into many small kernels; on short decode those overheads dominate.

sam: understood. paged-FA-v2 is optimized for long prefill memory locality and paged KV layouts, but decode with hot KV churn and tiny batches loses out. Two quick options: 1) routing rule to use fused-attn for small decode requests, 2) introduce a short continuous-batching delay (~2-8ms) as an opt-in per-customer knob.

jun: i sketched a selector patch locally:
```
if stage == PREFILL:
    choose(PAGED_FA_V2)
elif stage == DECODE and batch_size <= 2 and seq <= 48:
    choose(FUSED_ATTENTION)
else:
    choose(PAGED_FA_V2)
```
Smoke results: P50/P95 decode back to baseline on our internal cluster. I'll open a PR with unit tests.

ciara: watch out: fused-attn allocs a slightly different KV layout and can increase peak mem by ~5-8% for huge contexts. Gate the rule to decode-only and small contexts to avoid prefill OOMs. Also quantized kernels behave differently; we should run int8 smoke too.

maya: agreed. rollout plan: land selector fallback, canary 5%, monitor token latencies, kernel launch metrics, and OOMs. Also add a perf microbench in CI for small-decode. Filed RW-4491.

sam: add a CI gate: run small-decode microbench (b=1, seq=12) for any kernel selection changes. Fail if P50 increases >12% or kernel launches increase >30%. Also instrument runtime to emit kernel_launch_count per-request to metrics.

perf-bot: microbench run results:

sam: long-term we should add an auto-probe: track per-model latency delta when switching kernels and auto-tune selector thresholds per-customer. short-term route fallback + opt-in continuous-batching is safest.
